english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something whose own properties or claims contradict each other.
Use this when something contradicts itself, especially when it contains two opposing attitudes or claims.

examples.english: They say they do not believe in ghosts, but they are too scared to sleep at night—it is truly paradoxical.
examples.traditional: 佢話自己唔信鬼，但半夜又驚到唔敢瞓，真係自相矛盾。

examples.english: You say you want to leave one minute and do not want to leave the next; that is really contradictory.
examples.traditional: 你一時話想走，一時又話唔想走，真係自相矛盾。
